steps.message:
This is a one-line change, but session lifetime is a security-posture value, so I want your explicit go-ahead before editing rather than after.

`config.js:3` is `SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES: 30`, and `server.js` is the only consumer (sessions expire after that many minutes). Going 30m → 480m means a stolen or unattended session stays valid for a full working day instead of half an hour — a ~16x wider window for session hijacking or walk-up access on a shared machine.
